theme_strategy.aesthetic: Academic Warmth & Human-Centered Precision (Bleu ciel, Ocre, Sauge, Acier)
theme_strategy.description: Modern university LMS for Social Work in French. Blends academic authority (scholarly serifs, clean structural grids) with warm human-centered tones (ochre accent, sage badges, soft linen background).

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight text-foreground
hierarchy.subhead_label: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] font-sans font-bold text-accent-ochre

spacing_and_layout.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 sm:gap-8

navigation_header.style: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80 border-b border-border shadow-xs
elements: Role Switcher / Simulated User Login (Admin, Enseignant, Étudiant)

hero_landing.style: Relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-border bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-950 via-slate-900 to-amber-950 text-white p-8 sm:p-12 lg:p-16 my-6
features: Eyebrow badge: 'FACULTÉ DES SCIENCES HUMAINES & SOCIALES'
Interactive Stats: '4 Années d'Études', '5 Axes d'Intervention', 'Stage Pratique Inclus'
Quick Action Buttons: 'Explorer le Programme' & 'Accès Portail LMS'

program_catalog.card_style: Group relative rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-6 transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-primary/50

course_detail.accordions: Weekly sessions (Séances 1 à 12) with topics, PDF slides download, embedded video lecture (YouTube/Vimeo mockup), quiz card, assignment submission form
course_detail.progress_bar: Interactive checkbox tracking completion percentage for students
course_detail.discussion_forum: Accordion/Tab with student comments, questions to teacher, teacher answers badge

admin_teacher_dashboard.stats_row: Cards showing total enrolled students, active courses, pending assignments to grade
admin_teacher_dashboard.content_editor: Drawer/Modal to add new séance, edit course objectives, attach PDFs, add quiz questions
admin_teacher_dashboard.user_management: Searchable user table with filters (Rôle: Enseignant / Étudiant / Adm), action dropdowns (Assigner cours, Modifier, Suspendre)

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, accordions, modals, search bars, theme toggles, user rows) MUST include `data-testid` attributes in kebab-case format.
Do NOT center align the app container. Maintain left-aligned editorial hierarchy.
Use French language throughout the entire user interface, labels, buttons, notifications, and course mock data.
Ensure dark mode is fully functional using Tailwind `.dark` class toggle on root container / document element.
Always set explicit hover text color on buttons and interactive items to avoid unreadable contrast (e.g. `hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground`).
Use Lucide-react or Phosphor Icons for rich academic and LMS action icons (BookOpen, GraduationCap, ShieldCheck, Users, FileText, CheckCircle2, PlayCircle, MessageSquare, Plus, Trash2, Edit).
Components must use JavaScript `.js` or `.jsx` file extension as configured in this project.
